The Lord gave Jehoiakim into Nebuchadnezzar's hand. What does this show about God's control even in defeat?
"Daniel resolved that he would not defile himself." Where do you need to resolve to stay faithful?
Daniel respectfully asked for a test. How can you stand for your faith with wisdom and respect?
God gave the young men learning and skill. How has God equipped you?
Daniel asked his friends to pray for God's mercy. Who can you ask to pray with you?
Daniel praised God who "changes times and seasons; he removes kings and sets up kings." How does this give you peace?
Daniel said, "There is a God in heaven who reveals mysteries," not his own wisdom. How can you give God the credit?
God will set up a kingdom that shall never be destroyed. How does this point to Jesus' kingdom?
The three said, "Our God is able to deliver us... But if not, we will not serve your gods." What does "but if not" faith look like?
A fourth man was seen walking in the fire with them. How does God walk with you in the fire?
Nebuchadnezzar blessed their God who delivered them. How can your faithfulness point others to God?
Nebuchadnezzar told what God did for him. What has God done that you could tell?
Nebuchadnezzar's pride led to his humbling. Where does pride show up in you?
When Nebuchadnezzar lifted his eyes to heaven, his reason returned and he praised God. What does humility before God bring?
Belshazzar used the temple vessels for a drunken party. How do people treat holy things carelessly?
Daniel said Belshazzar had not humbled his heart though he knew all this. What do you know that should humble you?
"You have been weighed in the balances and found wanting." How does Jesus answer our being found wanting?
Daniel's enemies could find no fault in him except his faith. What does integrity at work look like?
Daniel prayed three times a day, "as he had done previously." How can prayer become your steady habit?
God shut the lions' mouths. When has God protected you?
Darius declared that Daniel's God is the living God. How does faithfulness point others to God?
Daniel saw the Ancient of Days on his throne. What does this vision show about God?
One like a son of man was given an everlasting kingdom. How did Jesus use this title for himself?
The kingdom will be given to the saints of the Most High. What hope does this give?
Daniel was overwhelmed by the vision and sought to understand it. How do you respond when you don't understand?
Daniel was sick from the vision but rose and did the king's business. How do you keep doing your work amid big worries?
Daniel prayed, confessing the sins of his people. How can you pray for your nation or church?
"To the Lord our God belong mercy and forgiveness." What does this mean to you?
Daniel prayed, "We do not present our pleas before you because of our righteousness, but because of your great mercy." How does this shape how you pray?
The angel said Daniel was "greatly loved." How does it feel to be greatly loved by God?
Daniel mourned and fasted for three weeks. What does deep seeking of God look like?
"From the first day that you set your heart to understand and humbled yourself before your God, your words have been heard." How does this encourage your prayers?
"O man greatly loved, fear not, peace be with you; be strong and of good courage." Where do you need this word?
"The people who know their God shall stand firm and take action." How does knowing God help you stand firm?
Some of the wise will stumble so they may be refined and made white. How does God use trials?
Many who sleep in the dust shall awake, some to everlasting life. How does the resurrection give you hope?
"Those who turn many to righteousness, like the stars forever and ever." How can you help others toward God?
God told Daniel, "Go your way till the end. And you shall rest and shall stand in your allotted place." What comfort does this give?
